Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card’s [On Play] effect to return my [Kristy Damon] to my hand even if I don't have a [Garudamon] in my hand?

Effect: [On Play] If played by an effect, by returning 1 of your [Kristy Damon]s to the hand, this Digimon may digivolve into [Garudamon] in the hand, ignoring its digivolution requirements and without paying the cost.
